data.name: MEDAL WINNERS
data.detailed_description:
Medal Winners captures the thrill of the Summer Games in a unique retro 2D style. In this competitive sports game, you can choose to play as a human or as one of several quirky animal characters, like a dog, cat, rabbit, wolf, or chicken, as you strive for victory in various events.

Single Player Mode: Compete in events against AI opponents, aiming to win more medals than your rivals in this tournament-style gameplay. You'll face procedurally generated rivals, ensuring each tournament is different and presents new challenges.

Two Player Mode: Grab a friend or family member for some friendly competition in local multiplayer matches. You have the choice to cooperate or face off against each other.ç

Story Mode: Immerse yourself in the Games journey through a captivating narrative where you create your own story filled with challenges and victories.

data.short_description: Win more medals than your opponents to rank at the top of the medal table in javelin throw, 100 metres, cycling, basketball shooting, pole vault, boxing, BMX, shot put, and other events across four different modes using humans or animals.
